svg.aria-label: Plan sheet, flat artwork on Dark Chocolate
svg.title: Plan sheet, flat artwork on Dark Chocolate

text.tspan: Floor planning at Sahra is approached as a balance between functionality, flow and spatial clarity,
where each layout is designed to support natural movement and everyday living. The organization of
spaces prioritizes openness, proportion and seamless transitions between areas, ensuring both
comfort and efficiency. Every plan is carefully structured to maximize usability while maintaining a
refined architectural rhythm that enhances the overall living experience.
